title: スターそらイトファンタジー　～空へ届く魔法～
description:
🌟Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky

Tokino Sora-chan is suddenly whisked away to another world in the middle of her live performance! 
A mysterious realm where her Hololive comrades and their precious items are scattered. 
Can Sora-chan unravel the secrets of this strange world and make it back to her stage!?

Guide Sora-chan’s story to a dazzling finale with your own hands!

🌟Explore and Conquer!Journey between the vibrant “The Nun Nun Square” and the enigmatic “Mysterious Tower” in a blend of 2D and 3D. 
Tackle intricate terrains, battle formidable foes, and dive into dynamic action and exploration alongside Sora-chan!

 

🌟Team Up with the Holomen!Sora isn’t alone—her Holomen friends have also been transported to this strange world! 
Find them, harness their unique skills, and band together to conquer the tower’s depths.

 

🌟Power Up with Holomen Items!Scattered throughout the tower are special items imbued with the Holomen’s powers. 
Collect them to enhance Sora’s abilities and unlock new paths in your adventure. 
The more you find, the stronger you become!

 

🌟Ride the Sora Train and explore the tower with total freedom! This incredible train whisks you instantly from the tower’s base to its deepest reaches, letting you move as you please. 

Aim for a 100% exploration rate as you uncover every corner of this tower!

 

🌟Uncover the Secret of the Sora Coins!Hunt for elusive “Sora Coins” hidden within the tower. 
Gather as many as you can and deliver them to a mysterious character for exclusive rewards!

 

🌟Sora’s Irresistible Charm!Beyond the thrilling main story, revel in Sora’s adorable dance moves, expressive poses, and vibrant emotions. 
Customize her look and soak in her charm at every turn!

Join Sora and the Holomen in Star Soraito Fantasy for a sparkling adventure filled with action, exploration, and heartwarming moments.
Solve the mysteries of another world and return to original world!

description_short: Tokino Sora zaps into another world mid-live! Join her Hololive friends in a thrilling Metroidvania-style action-adventure, blending 2D and 3D. Explore a mysterious realm, recover scattered items, and guide Sora’s epic tale to a dazzling finale!
